captions.text:
One hour before.
An air-raid alert is sounding.

A lone weather plane circles high above,
then flies away.

The all clear sounds.
The city goes back to its morning.

Trams fill with workers.
Children head to school.

Thousands of students work outdoors,
clearing firebreaks.

Only three planes, very high.
No siren sounds.

Their aiming point:
the T-shaped Aioi Bridge.

The bomber Bockscar was bound for Kokura.
Haze and smoke hid the city.

Low on fuel,
it turned toward Nagasaki.

A break opens in the clouds,
over the Urakami valley.

By the end of 1945, about 140,000 people
had died in Hiroshima,

Every 6 August, lanterns float on
Hiroshima's rivers in their memory.
